title: Global orientation and yoke-global
moment: First supported context-bearing event; retry only if delivery was missed
current: Current orientation requires a .yoke project root. Machine-wide user-level hooks for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor now reach projectless sessions and step aside inside projects; they deliver no global startup orientation yet.
planned: P1 makes session project optional; P2 installs/deduplicates user hooks; P3 scopes guards; P4 installs global orientation and yoke-global.
proposed_content: Identity and machine/connection readiness, no-project/registered-project context, one relevant next step, optional short cross-project status, and a yoke-global pointer.
Use yoke --help and https://upyoke.com/docs outside projects; do not point at cwd .yoke/docs.
Select/add projects globally, then carry intent into a session started in the selected project folder for /yoke onboard or item work.
Do not require a GitHub connection or sync as the price of continuing; preserve TUI sync silently off and later change.
